submission.justification: Based on comprehensive simulation analysis, Mixture-G1 with a 2.0 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 1.296 ns among all compliant options. Mixture-G2, while showing excellent time resolution (0.9 ns at 2 mm gap in preliminary tests), violates the hard environmental constraint with a GWP100 exceeding 150 and must be excluded. Mixture-G3, though compliant with environmental regulations, delivers significantly worse time resolution (2.069 ns at its optimal 2 mm gap). Mixture-G1 provides an improvement of 0.773 ns over G3, representing a 37% performance advantage while meeting all environmental and geometric constraints. The 2.0 mm gap represents the optimal operating point for G1, where time resolution is minimized within the allowed 1-3 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 at 2.0 mm gap achieves 1.296 ns time resolution, which is the best among compliant mixtures (G1 and G3). G2 is non-compliant due to GWP100 violation.
